question: When was the Amateur Athletics Federation of India (AAFI) established?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1946**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Amateur Athletics Federation of India (AAFI)** was established in the year **1946** as the apex body for athletics in India.
 
• The AAFI was founded with the goal of promoting and regulating athletics in the country and ensuring the participation of Indian athletes in international competitions.
 
• It is now known as the **Athletics Federation of India (AFI)** and serves as the governing body for athletics in India.
 
• AFI is affiliated with the **World Athletics** (formerly known as the International Association of Athletics Federations or IAAF), which governs athletics worldwide.
 
• The Athletics Federation of India organizes various national-level athletic events, trains athletes, and ensures their participation in global competitions, such as the Olympics, Asian Games, and Commonwealth Games.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1936**
 
 
• The year 1936 is historically significant for Indian athletics as it marks the participation of Indian athletes in the **Berlin Olympics**. However, the AAFI had not been established at this time.
 
• During the 1936 Olympics, Indian hockey team won gold, and the event was notable for the legendary athlete Jesse Owens' remarkable performance.
 
 
 
• **1956**
 
 
• The year 1956 is significant in Indian sports history as India participated in the **Melbourne Olympics**.
 
• Indian athletes competed in various events, but this year is not related to the establishment of the AAFI.
 
 
 
• **1966**
 
 
• In 1966, the **Asian Games** were held in Bangkok, Thailand, where Indian athletes won several medals.
 
• This year also saw the progress of Indian sports on the global stage, but it is unrelated to the founding of the AAFI.
 
 
 
• **Amateur Athletics Federation of India (AAFI)**
 
 
• The AAFI was established to promote and develop athletics at grassroots, national, and international levels in India.
 
• It was renamed as the **Athletics Federation of India (AFI)** in later years to better reflect its evolving role and responsibilities.
 
• AFI works towards organizing championships, selecting and training athletes, and ensuring adherence to international standards in competitions.
